'''Tiber Quent''' was an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The assassin's goal was to eliminate as many [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents as possible. Quent traveled to [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]] disguised as an Imperial courier with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that had information on it for [[Firestorm (plan)|Project Firestorm]]. He planned on using that as bait to get [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] to expose themselves and be [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Game" />

Quent was skilled in brewing poisons and carried a small poison kit that allowed him to create many different deadly substances. He was also skilled in the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="Game" />
